theme.intro: Quiet piano moments, familiar melodies, and a space to discover your own musical self.
theme.aboutTitle: Music to listen to. A world to belong to.
theme.aboutText: Harmosphere brings listening, discovery and practice together. Follow a melody, find your musical compass, or begin a small ritual at the piano.
theme.quizText: A quiet journey through the way you feel and experience music.
theme.journalText: Thoughts on listening, piano and the details that make a piece feel alive.
theme.resourcesText: Simple, thoughtful companions for your next moment at the keys.
theme.quizIntro: No theory, no right answers. Just 30 honest choices about the music that moves you. Start freely; save your discovery at the end.
theme.listenText: The same channel, three ways to follow along.
